title: Ciphertext adjacent-transition position prior v1
rationale: This lane predeclares a ciphertext-only adjacent-transition position target before scoring any future source-backed observation. It does not tune candidate key material, routes, plaintext claims, or additive-fragment matches, so it is not another pass over public-anchor-derived evidence.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in the committed high-transition-pressure positions if adjacent ciphertext transitions mark structurally important positions.
discovery_inputs: Fixed exclusion mask for already-known clue spans, used only to set the future non-anchor target universe

Fixed rule: map ciphertext letters to Kryptos alphabet order, sum circular adjacent-letter distances for each non-anchor position, choose the 20 highest-scoring positions, and tie-break by max adjacent distance then lower one-based position
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files with eligible source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before evaluation
Position-only scoring target that excludes known clue-span additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: source-backed observation file required before scoring
multiple-comparison context across all preregistered independent lanes before interpretation
require-unique-artifact gate for any lane intended to add a new prediction target
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat controls without post-hoc retuning
